title: NextTabletDriver theme
description: A user theme: overrides of the design tokens listed under `tokens`.

$schema.description: Optional: this schema's URL, for editor support.

base.description: Built-in theme that every token you do not set falls back to.

tokens.description: Token overrides. Names are the CSS variable names without the leading `--`.

bg-app.description: Window background. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

bg-panel.description: Cards, groups, menus and panels. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

bg-panel-hover.description: Panels and menu items under the pointer. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

bg-input.description: Background of inputs and dropdown triggers. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

bg-tab-active.description: Background of the active tab. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

text-main.description: Normal text. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

text-muted.description: Secondary text, hints and icons. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

text-active.description: Titles and hovered text. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

text-strong.description: Names and headings one step above normal text. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

text-emphasis.description: The strongest text (statistics, highlighted names). A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

text-on-accent.description: Text drawn on an accent-colored background. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

text-number.description: Numeric values in inputs. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

accent.description: Main theme color: selections, checkboxes, active widgets. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

accent-hover.description: Accent while hovered. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

border.description: Borders between cards and panels. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

border-hover.description: Borders of interactive cards while hovered. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

info.description: Informational status. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

warning.description: Warning status. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

error.description: Error status (log levels, validation). A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

danger.description: Destructive actions. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

danger-hover.description: Destructive actions while hovered. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

success.description: Success / running status. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

debug.description: Debug-level log lines. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

overlay-rgb.description: Channels of the color used for translucent highlights (white on dark themes, black on light themes). Three channels from 0 to 255 separated by spaces, e.g. `255 255 255`.

shade-rgb.description: Channels of the color used for translucent shadows and darkening. Three channels from 0 to 255 separated by spaces, e.g. `255 255 255`.

input-bg.description: Input field background. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

input-bg-hover.description: Input field background while hovered. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

input-bg-focus.description: Input field background while focused. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

input-border.description: Input field border. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

input-border-hover.description: Input field border while hovered. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

area-display.description: Display area in the output preview. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

area-tablet.description: Tablet area in the output preview. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

area-border-main.description: Outline of the tablet area. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

area-border-pink.description: Outline of the osu! playfield. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

area-playfield.description: Fill of the osu! playfield rectangle. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

area-contrast.description: Text and handles drawn over the preview areas. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

console-text.description: Log message text. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

titlebar-close-bg.description: Close button background while hovered. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

titlebar-close-fg.description: Close button icon while hovered. A color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() or transparent.

radius-sm.description: Smallest corner radius. A length in px, rem or em. At most 32px.

radius-md.description: Default corner radius (buttons, inputs). A length in px, rem or em. At most 32px.

radius-lg.description: Large corner radius (panels, menus). A length in px, rem or em. At most 32px.

radius-xl.description: Extra large corner radius (cards). A length in px, rem or em. At most 32px.

disabled-opacity.description: Opacity of disabled controls (0 to 1). A number. Between 0 and 1.

font-sans.description: Interface font stack. Only installed fonts can be used. A comma-separated list of installed font names.

font-mono.description: Monospace font stack (console, hashes). A comma-separated list of installed font names.
